title: Association between obsessive-compulsive symptoms, clozapine, and other antipsychotic treatment in psychotic disorders: a systematic review and meta-analysis of epidemiological findings
title_zh: 强迫症症状、氯氮平及其他抗精神病药物在精神障碍中的关联：流行病学发现的系统评价与荟萃分析
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Obsessive-compulsive symptoms (OCS) and obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) are common in schizophrenia spectrum disorders (SCZ), yet their aetiology remains unclear. Antipsychotics, particularly clozapine (CLZ), have been implicated, but the strength and consistency of this association remain uncertain. METHODS: A systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis was conducted to evaluate the incidence and prevalence of OCS and OCD in psychosis, comparing people treated with CLZ and other antipsychotics, including first and second generation. RESULTS: The search identified thirty two studies. The prevalence of OCS was similar between the CLZ-treated and the non-CLZ groups [41%, 95% CI: 28-54% vs. 30%, 95% CI: 22-38%; p = 0.183]. In contrast, OCD prevalence was significantly higher in the CLZ group [25%, 95% CI: 18-33% vs. 12%, 95% CI: 7-18%; p = 0.007]. De novo outcomes did not differ significantly between groups, de novo OCS was 26% [95% CI: 17-36%] with CLZ versus 14% [95% CI: 7-21%] with non-CLZ antipsychotics (p = 0.239), and de novo OCD was 22% [95% CI: 9-36%] versus 19% [95% CI: 17-21%] (p = 0.458). In the two studies that had measured the incidence of de novo OCS or OCD, the incidence rate was zero in all groups. CONCLUSIONS: These findings suggest a potential association between CLZ and increased rates of OCS and OCD in cross-sectional studies, though longitudinal evidence is lacking. Methodological limitations, including detection bias, confounding by indication and limited prospective data, highlight the need for further longitudinal and pharmacoepidemiologic research to clarify causal pathways.
abstract_zh: 引言：强迫症症状（OCS）和强迫症（OCD）在精神分裂谱系障碍（SCZ）中很常见，但其病因尚不明朗。抗精神病药物，特别是氯氮平（CLZ），已被认为与之相关，但这种关联的强度和一致性仍不确定。方法：进行了系统评价和随机效应荟萃分析，以评估精神病患者中OCS和OCD的发病率和患病率，比较氯氮平治疗组与其他抗精神病药物治疗组（包括第一代和第二代）。结果：搜索确定了32项研究。OCS的患病率在氯氮平组和非氯氮平组之间相似[41%，95% CI: 28-54% vs. 30%，95% CI: 22-38%; p = 0.183]。相比之下，OCD的患病率在氯氮平组显著更高[25%，95% CI: 18-33% vs. 12%，95% CI: 7-18%; p = 0.007]。新发结果在两组间无显著差异，新发OCS在氯氮平组为26% [95% CI: 17-36%] vs. 非氯氮平组14% [95% CI: 7-21%] (p = 0.239)，新发OCD为22% [95% CI: 9-36%] vs. 19% [95% CI: 17-21%] (p = 0.458)。在两项测量新发OCS或OCD发病率的研究中，所有组的发病率均为零。结论：这些发现表明，在横向研究中，CLZ与强迫症症状和强迫症的增加率存在潜在关联，尽管纵向证据不足。方法学局限性，包括检测偏差、适应症混杂和有限的前瞻性数据，凸显了需要进一步的纵向和药物流行病学研究以阐明因果途径。
